Dj.bar_b_note: The spider silhouette reads, but the mirror-bright all-gold metal looks like a trophy prop next to the naturalistic fur and plate of the style bar.

Ia.bar_b_note: A charming fennec read let down by a thin body that stands below the 1.80 m trainer and a faint-end tail that runs into the trainer's feet.

Yb.bar_b_note: Grounded boar anatomy, a mossy stone shell, a faint pose that rolls into the shell and a seated rider all carry it at Palworld finish.

Fy.bar_b_note: B's textured scales are close, but A's flat cel-shaded body and its faint poses floating in mid-air over a detached shadow sink the set.

Cv.bar_b_note: B's panel is legible and on direction, but the murky, near-colourless night world behind it has none of the light or density of the Palworld shots.

Qn.bar_b_note: A striking white, cyan and orange plumed silhouette with a readable face carries it, although faint mid barely differs from standing.

Gr.bar_b_note: The cobra's patterned scales are good, but no trainer ruler is visible and faint mid/end keep the hood raised, so the hurt state never reads.

Fo.bar_b_note: Real fur, a grounded bear stance, a clear faint slump and good scale against the ruler match the owner's Stormursa bar.

Oe.bar_b_note: A handsome spotted salamander that stands no taller than the trainer, and whose body and tail pass through the trainer in faint end.

Ld.bar_b_note: An appealing blue-white feathered read, sunk by the faint-end body collapsing onto the trainer and a carrying frame where nothing is carried.

Fv.bar_b_note: B adds a frame, cap and stone footing, but the untextured flat infill, a lone panel that reads like a shed door, a pale low-poly boulder and the flat painted-backdrop distance keep it far from Palworld and Valheim finish.

Hm.bar_b_note: Dense fur with glowing violet storm veins, an unmistakable silhouette and grounded hurt and faint poses sit right on the owner's style bar.

Ht.bar_b_note: A clear armoured-dragon silhouette, with copper spikes against navy plate, reads instantly, although faint mid/end change little.

Dn.bar_b_note: A warm, appealing elder with expressive eyes and a moss-green and leather palette that fits the Meadows, a touch more cartoon than the naturalistic creatures.

Ah.bar_b_note: A vivid, appealing cyan sea-dragon silhouette, sunk by a ridden frame with no visible rider.

top_changes.change: Fix the hurt and travel staging across the creature roster: ground the faint poses (Fy A floats in mid-air; Gr keeps its head up), stop faint-end bodies passing through the trainer (Ia, Oe, Ld), show the rider or carried load (Ah ridden, Ld carrying), and scale creatures that come in under the 1.80 m trainer (Ia, Oe) above it

Rebuild the homestead wall as a thick plank or wattle-and-daub section with textured infill and a timber frame that matches the village architecture family, so a placed run reads as a wall, not a lone door panel

Give the Meadows gameplay views key-art material and light: replace the pale low-poly boulder material, break the grass carpet into groves and edges, and add a warm time-of-day grade with atmospheric depth into the cool blue distance
